gate_msg: R^2=0.047 < minimum 0.05 — index barely explains the stock's returns

dimson.note: NOT a Dimson sum-beta. This slot carries the OWN-STOCK regression against EGX30 (beta 0.6981, R2 0.047, n=253), which failed the usability gate and is published as the labelled alternative framing beside the adopted tier-2 peer median. Blume cross-check on the own-stock fit: 0.7987.

SCEM.what: Suez Cement — the direct cement peer

ABUK.what: Abu Qir Fertilizers — heavy industrial, gas-intensive

adopted.basis: TIER 2 — same-country peer median. The own-stock regression against the published EGX30 index FAILS the usability gate (R2 0.047 < 0.05), so the strict preference order requires a peer beta rather than the failing estimate.
adopted.why: Median of the 5 usable Egyptian heavy-industrial regressions against EGX30: ABUK 0.6438, EGAL 0.9186, EGCH 1.0302, ELEC 1.0334, SWDY 1.2084. Suez Cement, the direct cement peer, is excluded because it too fails the gate (R2 0.025) — neither Egyptian cement name is well explained by EGX30.
adopted.gap: NOT unlevered and re-levered: peer balance sheets were not sourced from primary filings in this run. ARCC runs net cash, so re-levering to its own structure would give a LOWER beta and a HIGHER value — the unadjusted peer median understates value.

retired_composite.note: The beta this study carried until 01-Sep-2026, regressed against an equal-weight composite of the covered EGX names. A constituent composite is a HARD FAIL, not a tier. Recorded so the size of the correction is visible: 0.6281 -> 1.0302.
